title: Miller's experiment
back: 1953: CH₄, H₂, NH₃ + water vapour at 800 °C with electric discharge → amino acids. Supports Oparin–Haldane chemical evolution.

title: Homologous vs analogous
tex: \text{same origin, different use}\ \big|\ \text{different origin, same use}
back: Homologous (divergent): vertebrate forelimbs; Bougainvillea thorn and Cucurbita tendril. Analogous (convergent): bird and butterfly wings; potato and sweet potato.

title: Industrial melanism
back: Birds ate the moths that stood out. Natural selection in action, like antibiotic and herbicide resistance.

title: Adaptive radiation
back: Darwin's finches (Galapagos), Australian marsupials. Placental–marsupial look-alikes (wolf / Tasmanian wolf) show convergent evolution.

title: Hardy–Weinberg equation
back: Frequencies stay constant unless gene flow, drift, mutation, recombination or selection act.

title: Types of natural selection
back: Stabilising favours the mean; directional favours one extreme; disruptive favours both extremes (two peaks).

title: Darwin vs de Vries
back: Darwin: natural selection, fitness = reproductive fitness. de Vries worked on Oenothera lamarckiana.

title: Founder effect
legend: drift = chance change in small populations
back: A form of genetic drift: the new population may become a different species.

title: Brain capacity
back: Homo habilis | Homo erectus | Neanderthal. Dryopithecus and Ramapithecus about 15 million years ago.

title: Hardy–Weinberg disturbers
back: Gene flow, genetic drift, mutation, recombination, natural selection.
